* '''Original''' ([[Captain Moden Canady]]): PC card image of 7 August 2025<ref name="ht-mc-0">PC card image in the PC's Holotable image set: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/7821822/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual25-Dark/large/captainmodencanady.gif captainmodencanady.gif], commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/7821822 7821822] (7 August 2025).</ref>, no errata mark. The image uses the Decipher artwork with its “TM & © 1996 LUCASFILM LTD.” copyright line. Text: “Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. While piloting a [First Order] starship, it is armor and immunity to attrition +1 (if Fulminatrix, it is armor +2 and immune to attrition < 6 instead). During battle, cancels Alternatives To Fighting, Hit And Run, and opponent's 'reacts.'”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Captain Moden Canady (Errata)]]): Slip on the Players Committee's Virtual Set 25 release sheet<ref name="sheet25-20250810">Players Committee, [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-25.pdf Virtual Set 25 release sheet] (PDF, 10 pages, footer “SWCCG Players Committee, August 2025”; file created 10 August 2025). Released with [[Virtual Set 25]] (8 August 2025); the PDF is dated by its creation date.</ref>, page 1, file created 10 August 2025: “Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. While piloting a [First Order] starship, it is armor and immunity to attrition +1 (if Fulminatrix, it is armor +2 and immune to attrition &lt; 6 instead). During battle, cancels Alternatives To Fighting, Hit And Run, and opponent's 'reacts.'” '''What changed:''' Same words as [[Captain Moden Canady]] (Original). The sheet reprints the PC card image of [[Captain Moden Canady]] (published 7 August 2025) as a printable slip under the label “•Captain Moden Canady”, pixel for pixel the same except that the picture area is left blank (white), so the slip can be laid over the picture of the card named in its lower-left corner ([[Lieutenant Cabbel]]). A separate Players Committee publication, so its own version (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026: every publication is a version; a release-sheet slip and the PC card image are separate printings). '''Errata mark:''' the slip prints no errata mark, but it is errata 1 in release order; recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 November 2026).
* '''PC-E2''' (this page): PC card image of 8 December 2025<ref name="ht-mc-1">PC card image in the PC's Holotable image set: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/22b59ba/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual25-Dark/large/captainmodencanady.gif captainmodencanady.gif], commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/22b59ba 22b59ba] (8 December 2025).</ref>, no errata mark. What changed from the previous image: new artwork (the Decipher picture is replaced), and the vertical copyright line becomes “ARTWORK NEITHER AFFILIATED WITH NOR ENDORSED BY LUCASFILM LTD.” Game text unchanged. Text: “Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. While piloting a [First Order] starship, it is armor and immunity to attrition +1 (if Fulminatrix, it is armor +2 and immune to attrition < 6 instead). During battle, cancels Alternatives To Fighting, Hit And Run, and opponent's 'reacts.'”
